# Physical Education Foundation of India (PEFI)

> PEFI is India's premier organization dedicated to advancing physical education, sports development, and professional excellence in the fitness and coaching sectors.

PEFI operates from New Delhi and serves as a comprehensive hub for sports professionals, educational institutions, and fitness enthusiasts seeking certification, membership, and recognition in physical education. The organization provides structured programs, awards, and advocacy initiatives to promote sports development across India.

## Key Topics

- Physical Education
- Sports Development
- Membership Programs
- Sports Professionals
- Fitness Certification
- Coaching Excellence
- Sports Advocacy
- Institutional Partnerships
- Awards & Recognition
- Yoga Teacher Certification
- Sports Organizations
- Policy Advocacy
- Member Directory
- Professional Development
